records.title: [課題|かだい][理解|りかい] — Task
records.body: Listen to the conversation and decide what the person has to do next.

records.title: ポイント[理解|りかい] — Key point
records.body: Hear the question first, then listen for the one detail that answers it.

records.title: [概要|がいよう][理解|りかい] — Gist
records.body: Listen to the whole talk; the question comes at the end. Choose what it is mainly about.

records.title: [発話|はつわ][表現|ひょうげん] — What do you say?
records.body: Read the situation and choose what you would say.

records.title: [即時|そくじ][応答|おうとう] — Quick response
records.body: Listen to the short line and choose the best reply.
